SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(available_balance), 0) FROM bank_account WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS currentBalance,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM bank_transaction_log t INNER JOIN bank_account a ON t.account_id = a.card_number WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND t.transaction_type = 1) AS totalBorrowed,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM transfer_record WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1) AS totalTransferOut

SELECT t.date_str, SUM(t.in_amount) AS inAmount, SUM(t.out_amount) AS outAmount FROM ( -- 1. 统计转账记录 SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') AS date_str, CASE WHEN to_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END AS in_amount, CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END AS out_amount FROM transfer_record WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId}) AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
UNION ALL
-- 2. 统计借款/还款记录 SELECT DATE_FORMAT(log.create_time, '%m-%d') AS date_str, -- 借款(1)算收入 CASE WHEN log.transaction_type = 1 THEN log.amount ELSE 0 END AS in_amount, -- 还款(2)算支出 CASE WHEN log.transaction_type = 2 THEN log.amount ELSE 0 END AS out_amount FROM bank_transaction_log log INNER JOIN bank_account a ON log.account_id = a.card_number WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND log.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ) t GROUP BY t.date_str ORDER BY t.date_str ASC
